description: Source code for managing access control policies in a SQL store within the Mattermost server, including functions for saving, deleting, updating status, retrieving, and searching policies with versioning and history tracking.

classes.name: SqlAccessControlPolicyStore
classes.description: Implements storage and management of access control policies in a SQL database, including CRUD operations, versioning, and search functionalities.

methods.name: toModel
methods.description: Converts stored policy data into a model.AccessControlPolicy object.

methods.name: fromModel
methods.description: Creates a stored policy object from a model.AccessControlPolicy.

methods.name: Save
methods.description: Saves a new or updated access control policy into the database, handling versioning and history.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes a policy by ID, saving its state to history before removal.

methods.name: SetActiveStatus
methods.description: Updates the active status of a policy, including cascading updates for parent policies.

methods.name: SetActiveStatusMultiple
methods.description: Batch updates active status for multiple policies.

methods.name: getT
methods.description: Internal method to fetch a policy within a transaction context.

methods.name: getHistoryT
methods.description: Internal method to fetch the latest historical version of a policy.

methods.name: GetAll
methods.description: Retrieves all policies matching specified options, with pagination.

methods.name: SearchPolicies
methods.description: Searches policies based on search criteria, including term, type, parent ID, and inclusion of children.

methods.name: GetPoliciesByFieldID
methods.description: Finds policies referencing a specific property field ID in their CEL rule expressions.
